name: Aylesbury Plumbing Solutions
description: Aylesbury's most trusted plumbing and heating specialists with over 20 years of experience serving homes and businesses across Buckinghamshire. From emergency call-outs and boiler installations to bathroom refits and landlord certificates, our Gas Safe registered engineers deliver prompt, professional service at competitive rates. We're available 24/7 for emergencies and guarantee all our work for 12 months.
shortDescription: Expert plumbing, heating and gas services for homes and businesses across Aylesbury and Buckinghamshire.

name: The Crown Kitchen
description: A beloved Aylesbury institution serving modern British cuisine with a seasonal menu that celebrates the best of Buckinghamshire produce. From our famous Sunday roasts to weekday lunches and celebratory dinners, The Crown Kitchen offers a warm, relaxed atmosphere perfect for every occasion. Private dining available for up to 24 guests. Booking recommended at weekends.
shortDescription: Modern British cuisine using seasonal Buckinghamshire produce. Sunday roasts, lunches and dinners in a relaxed setting.

name: Glow Beauty & Wellness
description: A boutique beauty salon in the heart of Aylesbury offering a full range of treatments.
shortDescription: Boutique beauty salon offering facials, nails, waxing and wellness treatments.

name: Bucks Auto Centre
description: Buckinghamshire's premier independent garage, Bucks Auto Centre has been keeping Aylesbury's vehicles on the road since 1998. Our team of fully qualified technicians handle everything from routine servicing and MOT testing to complex diagnostics and engine rebuilds. We work on all makes and models, offer competitive pricing, and provide free courtesy cars for longer jobs. Approved by leading warranty providers.
shortDescription: Independent garage offering MOT testing, servicing and repairs on all makes and models. Free courtesy cars available.

name: Peak Legal & Financial
description: Peak Legal & Financial is a full-service firm providing expert legal and financial advice to individuals and businesses throughout Buckinghamshire. Our experienced team of solicitors and financial advisers specialise in residential conveyancing, family law, wills and probate, commercial property, and independent financial planning. We pride ourselves on plain-English advice, transparent fees, and genuine personal service.
shortDescription: Full-service solicitors and financial advisers specialising in conveyancing, family law, wills and commercial property.

name: Market Square Boutique
description: Independent fashion boutique in Aylesbury town centre.
shortDescription: Independent fashion boutique stocking women's clothing, accessories and gifts from independent designers.
